changelog: THE MAP HAS SECRETS NOW. Skirmish nodes show a scouting report before you commit (objective, enemy force, raiders), and Forward Scouts reveal what a ? becomes. Escape the Death Bog once and every future run hides a Rumour node off the survey, which you can only find with Forward Scouts or a Field Compass. Early choices echo: some Act I decisions pay off in later acts, and events no longer repeat within a run. You choose your rewards. Event rewards that used to pick for you are now pick-one-of-three, or you choose the card from your deck. Card offers lean toward the deck you are building, and a pity counter makes a rare likelier after every offer without one. Camp training offers branch perks (Hold Ground, Overrun, Spotter, Ranging Shots, Pack Hunter) alongside the old drill. The ground fights back. Fire spreads through forest and gas; water and mire are firebreaks; hills survive a burn. Mire now poisons anything that ends its turn in it, as well as slowing it. Forest turns aside ranged fire. Each act has its own terrain. Upgraded Provoke drags its target into fire, gas or an EMP. Smarter enemies, some of them. Rocket teams, snipers, artillery, bannermen and prototype crews are Tacticians: they use cover, avoid hazards and fall back when wounded. Everything else still walks into your fire. The unit card tells you which is which. More ways to win a fight. Order a withdrawal from a skirmish, at the cost of all your salvage and a quarter of each unit's health. Hold every command node uncontested for 7 rounds to win outright. Place your army before turn one. Every event now offers a real choice. The enemy has a name: the Host of Apollyon. Ascension 7-12 add new rules instead of bigger numbers. Achievements are rewritten in the Quartermaster's voice. New stencil headings. A keyword glossary in card details and How to Play. Fixes: stuns from Suppressing Fire, upgraded Incite Mutiny and the Lance charge now actually cost the target its turn. The collection now reveals every card you have been shown (offers, shop stock, conjured One-Shots, crate cards) and counts curses you are dealt. Also includes everything from 0.0.73: the translation layer, text-free button art with drawn labels, and the Engineer's power renamed Surge.
